name: Language-Aware Images
description: TMDB images in your library's language with a clean fallback to English, no more textless posters.
overview: Drop-in replacement for the built-in TMDB image provider. Enforces a clean cascade: library language → English → (optional) textless. Within each bucket images are sorted by vote_count DESC like TMDB's own /images UI. Fixes jellyfin/jellyfin#9878 (built-in prefers textless over English fallback).
changelog: Collections and thumbs. The plugin is now offered as an image fetcher for collections, including the ones the TMDb Box Sets plugin creates (issue #5): posters and backdrops follow the same language cascade as movies. Movies, series and collections also get thumbs (issue #6), the titled landscape art Jellyfin's built-in TMDB provider offers, ranked by language as well; a new option lets a textless backdrop fill in when there is no titled one. TMDB has no banners, keep Fanart or TVDB enabled for those.
